headline: October 26 Bitcoin Put Skew Prints 8.68 Vol Points Against 18.94 On The October 25 Contract
narrative: Bitcoin put skew on the October 26 contract prints 8.68 vol points, against 18.94 vol points on the October 25 contract, so downside protection is cheaper on the next expiry than on the contract that still carries the wider gap. The pipe subtracts call implied volatility from put implied volatility at the listed strikes nearest 10 percent from spot, and a wider positive gap means hedges cost more than upside. The October 26 contract marks a 73k put at 60.53 percent against an 89k call at 51.85 percent, while the October 25 contract marks a 74k put at 73.62 percent against an 89k call at 54.68 percent.
